name: io.github.veronchenko/inkwell-memory
title: Inkwell
description: Persistent memory for AI agents: Markdown entries, hybrid search, typed graph links

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Host folder holding the knowledge base, mounted at /knowledge in the container

knowledge_path.description: Absolute path on the host where entries and the search index are stored

environmentVariables.name: INKWELL_DATA_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Knowledge base root inside the container; matches the volume mount target

environmentVariables.name: INKWELL_ENABLE_DASHBOARD
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to skip the web dashboard process and run the MCP server only
